The '''Grendin River''' was a river on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. [[Nym's Stronghold]] was built next to the river, a bridge connected it with the [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] on the other side.<ref name="SWG" /> Some legs of the [[Lok Marathon]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] track followed the bed of this river.<ref name="SWG:LM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grendin River first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Its name was revealed during the Lok Marathon swoop race.<ref name="SWG:LM" />
